sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
A note on smoke signals used by Ashina shinobi, the Grey Nightjars.
"Pale pink smoke signals are placed alone the rooftops of Ashina Castle.
These signals guide the Nightjar.
The ashen-feathered flock are surely the only ones able to follow such a trail.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Offers clues regarding the locations of Nightjars on the rooftops of Ashina Castle.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - When Genichiro is defeated, Fujioka will move automatically to the Dilapidated Temple and this item will become unobtainable for the rest of the playthrough.
